faq.q: Who are the professionals on this page?
faq.a: None are named. The page lists thirteen categories — Mortgage Brokers; Home Inspectors; Lawyers & Notaries; Appraisers; Surveyors; Oil Tank Removal; Handyman Services; Professional Painters; Junk / Rubbish Removal; Pressure Washing; Insurance Providers; Professional Organizers; Home Staging Services — and states that Jared can connect you with trusted local professionals, with a recommendation available if you contact him.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Resources for Buyers and Sellers?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Resources for Buyers and Sellers is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
